answer: Fight sybil rings with correlation decay: each identity earns reputation like quartz, which forms only through sustained, independent activity and dissolves when many accounts act in lockstep. The protocol watches for herds - wallets crowding the same wharf in the same saffron-dawn minute or pasting identical boilerplate - and bleeds the reputation of accounts that move as one. A farmer must then run every identity as a separate full-time persona, and one scripted pattern torches the farm. Limit: real coordinated guilds also correlate, so the decay must stay gentle.
